_note: Small adjustments Drop offers when a routine slips (CONTEXT.md: Comeback Card, Simplify my plan). Rules pick one; the AI may only word it. Never zero: every shrink keeps a minimum.

library.text: A 10-minute walk instead of 30, just for this week
library.why: A smaller step you can keep beats a bigger one you skip.
library.source: WHO 2020 physical activity guidelines: some activity is better than none

library.text: A 15-minute walk after breakfast, before work gets busy
library.why: Your missed walks were on busy days; mornings are more yours.

library.text: 10 minutes of stairs or brisk walking indoors on rainy days
library.why: The weather got in the way, so the plan moves indoors.

library.text: On travel days, a 10-minute walk at the station or hotel
library.why: You were travelling; a short walk fits around it.

library.text: Same wake-up time every day this week, and screens off 30 minutes earlier
library.why: Your sleep dropped under 6 hours on most nights; a fixed wake time helps most.
library.source: AASM / CDC sleep guidance: 7+ hours for adults

library.text: Keep the iron add-on to 3 days, always with lunch
library.why: Tying it to one meal makes it easier to remember.
library.source: Habit formation: anchoring a habit to an existing routine

library.text: On fasting days, rajgira or a handful of roasted chana after the fast
library.why: A festival week changed your meals; these fit fasting days.

library.text: While travelling, roasted chana or a boiled egg as your iron add-on
library.why: Easy to carry and found at most stations.

library.text: Rest this week: a 5-minute stretch only when you feel up to it
library.why: You weren't well; rest comes first.
